verdict.rationale: Goodwin shows international reach relevant to venture work: offices across North America, Europe and Asia (London, Munich, Paris, Luxembourg, Hong Kong, Singapore), VC fund formation attorneys raising "domestic and international funds," and UK incentives expertise. However, nothing in the evidence documents cross-border startup financings, flips or redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction deal work, and the Founders Workbench formation tooling covers Delaware entities only. Missing for 10: documented flip/redomiciliation practice, multi-jurisdiction financing deal examples, international investor representation in startup rounds, independent corroboration.
